messages:
rachel_billing: Payment from Nebula Health (INV-2154, $4,750) failed — issuer returned 'fraud_suspected' and blocked the transaction. Cardholder contacted us; says issuer flagged Redwood as unusual. Need guide for quickest recovery (prefer card retry today).

csm_tom: I called their AP. They can ask the cardholder to call the bank and whitelist the vendor, but they want a secure retry link instead if possible.

payments-bot: Stripe event: `payment_intent.payment_failed` -> `decline_code=fraud_suspected`; PaymentIntent pi_4Gh7... origin: card. Logged on /payments/INV-2154.

stripe-bot: Hosted 3DS retry link available if issuer requires auth: https://checkout.stripe.com/retry/pi_4Gh7... (expires 24h). Note: if issuer fully blocks for fraud, cardholder must contact bank.

rachel_billing: Can we offer one-click fallback to ACH for this customer? They prefer card but can do ACH same-day if we provide faster instructions.

treasury_sam: For amounts <$5k we can accept same-day Faster Payments (UK) or SEPA instant where supported, but need email confirmation and updated payment terms. For US ACH same-day: require explicit payer consent via signed email.

csm_tom: I'll get verbal confirmation and follow up with an email consent. Also I'll send the retry link now and advise them to have cardholder call bank if 3DS doesn't surface.

legal_anya: Quick note: keep the email consent record in the payment ticket for audit. If they choose ACH, attach payer email consenting to debit.

rachel_billing: Sent email to AP with retry link + ACH instructions + checklist. Copying key text: "If your bank continues to block the attempt, reply with explicit consent to pay via ACH and we'll provide wire/ACH details and extend due date by 72 hours once we receive confirmation."

csm_tom: Customer called bank; issuer removed block. They authenticated via 3DS and payment captured. :tada:

payments-bot: Payment captured for INV-2154. Record updated. Closing thread.
